_about: Equipment rows come from the client's relic tables. `_exclude` drops rows players never see in a run: the eq_dpt_test balance-test rows, the eq_tut tutorial copies (two share a name with the real eq_pub item), the eq_story quest item and the eq_event event reward. The client's item icons (`icon_name`) are not in the extracted folders, so `image_path` points at the community wiki icons the app already ships in itens/, matched to each item once by name. Items with no wiki icon have no image, which the UI handles.
